name: daily-health-digest
prompt: Run the oncall-triage skill in digest mode: read the webhook events of the last 24 hours (GET /__api/webhooks/events?kind=custom/alerts), the runbook runs recorded in ./runs/, and the state of every session in this project folder. Publish a one-page digest as an artifact. Prefix the summary with [SILENT] if there were no alerts and no failed runs.

name: oncall-sweep
prompt: Run the oncall-triage skill: check for webhook alert events since the last sweep and triage each new one. Reply [SILENT] if there is nothing new.
